prompt: A large warehouse needs its interior walls painted, totaling 4800 square feet. Painter Alex can paint at a rate of 100 square feet per hour, and Painter Beth can paint at a rate of 80 square feet per hour. They both start working together. After 6 hours, Alex has to leave due to another commitment, and Chris joins Beth. Chris can paint at a rate of 120 square feet per hour. How many additional hours will it take for Beth and Chris to finish painting the remaining area?
